title: fix(cli): os migrate apply lists the schema-sync index step before its [y/N] prompt

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os migrate apply` 在 `[y/N]` 确认前，现在会列出确认后要建的那个运行时索引（权限集授权表的无包唯一约束），和 `os migrate plan` 的列法、位置一致。
- 为什么改：运维答 `y` 之前看到的清单少了一条 DDL，确认后 apply 却会执行它；文档承诺“apply 要做的一切都在提示前显示”，原来没做到。
- 风险与回滚：只多打印一段只读查询的结果，不改执行内容、不改 `--json`、不改变更计数；回滚即撤销 `apply.ts` 里新增的一处调用。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts`（新增的渲染调用）、`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.schema-sync-indexes.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/apply.schema-sync-indexes.integration.test.ts`，预期 3/3 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`os migrate apply` printed the held-back schema work and the drift before its `[y/N]` prompt, but not the runtime-owned index its flush builds once that DDL is done: `sys_user_permission_set.uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless` (the permission-set grant's package-less guard). `os migrate plan` has listed it since #32460 (PR #32650).

Apply now calls the same `collectSchemaSyncIndexes` and `renderSchemaSyncIndexes` from `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-sync-indexes.ts`, in the same place as plan: after the held-back work, before the drift, the order the apply performs them in. One deliberate difference from plan: `applyPerformsWork` is `intended.length > 0 || pending.length > 0`, the exact condition under which apply flushes (`totalIntended`), because apply knows whether `--allow-destructive` was passed; plan can only use `drift.length > 0`.

Human face only. The `--json` document and the change count in the prompt are unchanged. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` ("everything apply is about to do is on screen before the `[y/N]` prompt") is now true as written, so no doc change.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.schema-sync-indexes.integration.test.ts` runs the real command over a real SQLite file on an interactive terminal (stdin TTY, `node:readline` answering `n`, so the database is read back unchanged):

1. fresh database: the guard is listed on the grant table the same apply creates, directly under the "Runtime-owned indexes" heading, after the held-back `create_table`, before the `[y/N]` question; `n` leaves no table and no index;
2. upgraded grant table without the guard: listed as a plain build before the prompt;
3. CONTROL, guard already stands: no section, because apply sends it no DDL.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation of the render call to a function returning no lines, at d5e05965 + the test commit ee3f95214d; the CLI vitest imports `src/` directly, so no dist rebuild): cases 1 and 2 go red, case 3 stays green; restore verified (`git diff HEAD` empty, blob back to `bc13e37a1e3a`).

```
AssertionError: no index section in:
AssertionError: no index step in:
      Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
ablation-replace:   git diff HEAD       empty
```

</details>

The later commit 2e3990667b adding module-top imports (`check:test-source-alias`) changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface held: `apply.ts`, its new test, one changeset. `migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` (PR #32558) untouched.
- origin/main merged once before the PR opened (plain merge, no rebase).
